Pirates: Building a Pirate Family.

Chapter 1100: New World War (Death of Saint Green)

chevron_leftPrev Nextchevron_right nights_stay

Under the astonished gazes of the crowd, Ben Beckman raised the spear in his hand and pointed it at his forehead.

There was a snap.

The seastone bullet pierced Ben Beckman's head.

The skull was directly flipped over.

"Vice Captain!"

The remaining members of the Red Hair Pirates exclaimed as they saw Ben Beckman collapse and commit suicide.

This time, not only the captain died, but the deputy captain was also gone.

So what should they do?

"Run, get out of here, retain your strength, and avenge the captain and the others!"

Lazi Lu looked at the bodies of the captain and the deputy captain, gritted his teeth, and tears burst out of his eyes.

Ignoring her tears, she pulled the few remaining companions and left quickly while everyone's eyes were on the captain and the deputy captain.

That's it!

No one noticed that Lacy Lu had left here with the remnants of the Red Hair Pirates on the Red Force.

Maybe it wasn't that no one hadn't noticed.

But I no longer care. The captain is dead and the deputy captain is dead too.

The Red Hair Pirates have collapsed, and these remnants can't make any waves.

Charlotte looked at Shanks who died with his eyes open.

Slowly pulled the sword out of Shanks.

The blood was stained on the Seven Star Sword.

The weird color is fully revealed.

"Charlotte!"

Along with this roar that shook the earth and sky, the sadness and anger contained in it seemed to be able to break through the clouds.

Everyone was shocked to find that the Ancient Saint Green, who was already on the verge of death, suddenly burst out with amazing power from somewhere, like a released wild beast, and ran straight towards Charlotte.

The long sword in his hand exuded a frightening domineering aura of a king, and he rushed towards Charlotte with fierce power.

Charlotte did not dare to delay at all. He stood up suddenly, pushed the ground hard with his feet, and shot out like an arrow. At the same time, he raised the sword in his hand to prepare for the opponent's attack.

Ancient Saint Green's speed at this time was jaw-droppingly fast. In the blink of an eye, he rushed in front of Charlotte and slashed at Charlotte fiercely with the long sword in his hand.

But in front of Charlotte, this speed was as slow as a turtle.

\"God slash!\"

Charlotte let out a low roar, and his sword drew an arc in the air.

The sharp sword energy gushed out instantly, spanning a distance of a hundred meters. With unparalleled power, the sword swept across the air and slashed towards Ancient Saint Green at an astonishing speed.

Ancient Saint Green had no time to react at all before the sword was already in front of him.

Puff! The sword light pierced through the body.

A bright light flashed from the waist of the Ancient Saint Green.

Blood gushed out. Ancient Saint Green stopped charging forward and stopped where he was, spitting out a mouthful of blood.

His face turned pale and the long sword in his hand fell to the ground.

"How can it be……!"

Ancient Saint Green widened his eyes and looked at his wound in disbelief.

Charlotte looked at Ancient Saint Green coldly.

"The family must be neat and tidy."

After saying that, Charlotte swung his sword again. This time the sword light was even brighter and as hot as the sun.

Ancient Saint Green wanted to dodge, but his body was no longer under his control and he could only watch the sword light coming towards him.

puff!

The sword light pierced through the chest of Ancient Saint Green and completely shattered his heart.

Ancient Saint Green opened his eyes wide, his body slowly fell down, his eyes filled with despair and unwillingness.

boom!

His body fell to the ground, his eyes looking lifeless in the direction of Shanks.

The pupils gradually dilated and the eyes became lifeless.

Eventually lost its color.

Charlotte looked at the body of Ancient Saint Green indifferently, with no ripples in her heart.

“It’s neat!”

Charlotte drew out his sword and turned his wrist.

The blood on the tip of the sword flew away.

Standing proudly beside the body of the Ancient Saint Green.

Kill these two people!

It took Charlotte less than five minutes.

Then Charlotte looked at Esdeath.

Just now, Charlotte decided to kill Shanks.

Because of the obstruction of Ancient Saint Green, it was a little slow.

Saint Satan and Saint Vochuli had already reacted and wanted to stop it.

But I didn't expect Esdeath to suddenly attack.

Esdeath withstood the pressure from Saint Nasujuro and Saint Pitt, and stopped Saint Satan and Saint Vochuli.

Create time for Charlotte to kill Shanks.

five minutes!

To the strong, it is extremely precious.

Charlotte successfully killed the two father and son pairs, Shanks and Ancient Saint Green.

Esdeath seemed to be at ease under the siege of four people.

But you can still see some difficulty.

With Esdeath's strength, it should be no problem for her to deal with two or three of the Five Elder Stars.

Although the Five Elders seem to be very powerful, their attack power is actually just so-so. The only trouble is that they are very difficult to kill.

This is the reason why the Five Elders were able to fight with Charlotte for nearly five days.

Similarly, Esdeath only needs to restrain these four of the Five Elders.

"Charlotte!"

When the Five Elders saw Charlotte killing Shanks and Ancient Saint Green one by one, they became completely furious.

But their fury seemed insignificant.

Neither Charlotte nor Esdeath took the rage of the four of them seriously.

"Let's go together and kill all four of them!"

There was the previous example of killing Mazi Saint.

Charlotte was no longer afraid.

Esdeath heard this and said nothing, but swung out with her sword.

The cold instantly enveloped the surroundings, freezing the entire battlefield.

Created a solid arena.

When Satan Sheng and others saw this, they retreated in a group!

"How to do?"

Saint Satan transmitted the message to the other three in his mind.

"There's no need to fight any more. Shanks is dead, Ancient Saint Grimm is also dead, and the Whitebeard Pirates and BIGMOM Pirates are also with their remnants. We have completely failed this time!"

Nasujuro Sei looked at Charlotte and Esdeath with a serious expression.

"Then retreat!"

Saint Satan said.

"Well, retreat!"

The three of them nodded in unison.

When Charlotte saw the three of them nodding, she immediately realized something was wrong!

"Do it!"

Charlotte's figure flashed and quickly approached the four people.

"Teleport!"

A black pentagram rose from under Saint Satan's feet, and he raised his forelimbs to block Charlotte's attack.

next second!

The black light enveloped the four people, and in an instant, their figures disappeared from the Cake Island.

Charlotte's attack missed!

He stared with wide eyes at the empty battlefield.

\"Run away?\"

Charlotte murmured to herself, feeling an indescribable sense of loss in her heart.

For the first time, he truly experienced what those enemies who had faced him before felt when faced with the ability to teleport - the frustration of watching the enemy escape but being unable to do anything.

Charlotte's face became extremely gloomy, and her heart was filled with resentment and anger.

Even though he killed Shanks and Ancient Saint Green, the fire in Charlotte's heart still burned in his chest.

Nowhere to vent.

Especially when you are about to accomplish your goal.

Just when he was about to defeat his opponent, the victory was taken away by the space teleportation skill.
